propositions: JiraDataCenterTransport.update_issue submits status as a field edit via issue.update(fields=...) instead of routing it through transition_issue_by_name, causing Jira to reject the status change silently since status is not an editable field

Cloud transport (JiraDataCenterTransport) has status-to-transition routing in its update_issue path while Data Center transport does not, creating an asymmetry that prevents outbound status mutations from reaching DC instances

Outbound test cell test_outbound_mutation_round_trips[04-transition-status] fails on DC with status remaining 'To Do' because the status field edit is rejected by Jira, whereas the same test passes on Cloud due to its status routing logic

The fix requires extracting transition resolution logic into a shared module and routing status through route_status_to_transition in JiraDataCenterTransport.update_issue while preserving field-edit routing for other allowlisted fields like assignee
Illegal transitions that cannot be reached from the current workflow state must be handled non-fatally as bridge alerts rather than failing the entire batch
Live evidence from a real Data Center instance harness run confirms the cell transitions-status test passes post-fix and failed pre-fix with the exact reported symptom
